Exact evidence line: "2026-02-28 | PEPIZO FOODS LLP | TO THE ORDER | FROZEN POTATO PRODUCT/HASH BROWN- | MUNDRA SEA INMUN1, India | Port Louis, MAURITIUS | 20049000 | BOL 1143655". Additional rows seen: 2026-02-27 French Fries HS 20041000 Mundra Sea -> Jebel Ali, UAE, BOL 1069630; 2026-02-24 French Fries HS 20041000 -> Jebel Ali, UAE, BOL 9977593; 2026-02-21 French Fries HS 20041000 -> Umm Qasr, IRAQ, BOL 9902528; 2026-02-19 French Fries HS 20041000 -> Kaohsiung, TAIWAN, BOL 9813098. Declared HS 200410/200490 matches the observed customs HS codes 20041000/20049000.
note: Export side is factually confirmed: real sea shipments from Mundra (INMUN1) with dates, destinations (Mauritius, UAE, Iraq, Taiwan), HS 20041000/20049000 and B/L numbers — not a website claim. Source counter vs rows seen: 344 shipments claimed by ImportKey vs 5 rows visible in the free view (paywalled beyond that); a second slug variant 'pepizo-foods-llp-2' returned an empty record set, so only one slug yielded data. Domestic supply (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be verified: DuckDuckGo search backend was down (connection refused), Google returned HTTP 429, Bing returned irrelevant results, and registry/aggregator pages (zaubacorp, thecompanycheck) returned HTTP 403 — and registries are out of scope for this role anyway. Therefore domestic_status = unknown, not 'none_found': absence of public evidence was not established, only that it was not retrievable within the tool budget. Revenue and export volume figures: null — ImportKey free view gives shipment counts, not values, and no rupee/USD turnover figure is public in the sources read. No CIN/PAN asserted. Trader/manufacturer role not assessed here (shipments-evidence role only); note that the company also appears as an importer of food-processing machinery from Chinese suppliers (Hiwell Machinery Shandong, Shandong Xindaxin, Foshan Samfull Packaging), which is consistent with own processing capacity but does not by itself prove manufacturing status.
